title: SDK docs gap checklist + quick log
content:
Short running scratchpad for gaps I keep bumping into when helping integrate customers and pairing with eng on SDK fixes. Not a polished PRD, just daily notes + action checklist.

=== Context / scope ===
- Focus: SDK docs and small sample apps that block quick customer onboarding (first 30 min to hello-world).
- Platforms: Python, Node (both ESM/CJS), and a tiny TypeScript example for Vite-based apps.
- Goal: triage 1 small doc gap per day, ship a tiny PR, link to cookbook page.

=== Today (2026-03-10) quick log ===
- 09:15 pairing w/ Owen on streaming example mismatch (Node SDK). We found two problems:
  1) example uses "response.on('data')" style but our SDK emits an async iterator in README. Need unified example.
  2) bundler note missing for ESM consumers (Vite). Add a short note: "use sdk/dist/esm and ensure node 18+ or polyfill fetch".
- 11:00 customer call — embedding batch example confused them (batch size semantics). They thought batch=per-request not per-call. Add clarifying paragraph + small code snippet.
- 14:00 quick PR drafted for python quickstart typo (env var name). PR link in linked_artifacts.

=== Open gaps (prioritized) ===
1) Node streaming example inconsistency (high)
   - Action: replace old event-emitter example with async-iterator pattern and provide minimal adapter function for legacy users.
   - Owner: Priya -> open PR -> assign Jamie review.
   - Time estimate: 1.5 hrs.

2) ESM bundler guidance (medium)
   - Add one-paragraph "Vite / ESM consumers" note under Node quickstart. Mention: node 18+, set "type":"module" or use .mjs, import from 'redwood-sdk/esm' path.
   - Include common error snippet + fix.
   - Time estimate: 45 min.

3) Embeddings batch semantics (high)
   - Problem: examples show batching by passing array per call; docs don't explain cost semantics or recommended batch sizes.
   - Action: add "How to choose batch size" subsection with throughput/latency tradeoffs and example using async worker pool.
   - Linked tickets: JIRA-789 (linked).

4) Function calling example with tooling (low)
   - Current sample is long and uses older schema. Simplify to a 12-line example that shows declaring functions and a verify step.
   - Add note on fallback when function call fails.
   - Time: 2 hrs (after streaming fix).

5) Quickstart mismatch: TypeScript types missing one param (modelVersion)
   - Action: bump types, add test-snippet in repo.
   - Owner: Sasha.

=== Micro tasks (grab & ship today) ===
- [ ] Update README streaming section + small adapter snippet. (PR: draft, need test run)
- [ ] Add Vite note to Node quickstart (small commit)
- [ ] Insert short paragraph in embeddings doc about cost and batch sizing
- [ ] Fix env var name in python quickstart (merge PR)

=== Example snippets to add (drafts) ===
- Node streaming async-iterator (short):
  const resp = await client.generateStream({ model: 'redwood/gpt-1', prompt: 'hi' });
  for await (const chunk of resp) console.log(chunk.text);

- Adapter for event-emitter users (one-liner):
  // convert old emitter to async iterator
  async function emitterToAsync(e) { for await (const c of e) yield c; } // note: pseudocode

- Embedding batch doc: sample pattern
  async function embedInBatches(items, batchSize=32) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i=0; i<items.length; i+=batchSize) {
      const slice = items.slice(i, i+batchSize);
      const r = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-compact', input: slice });
      out.push(...r.data.map(x => x.embedding));
    }
    return out;
  }

=== Questions / blockers (notes to self) ===
- Who owns the canonical "how batching works" doc for embeddings? (is it eng-serving-runtime or devx?)
- Need perf numbers for recommended batch sizes (16, 32, 64) on dedicated vs hosted — ask infra for a quick run.
- Is there a standard template for "breaking change" notes for SDK releases? I keep drafting but the legal/marketing checklist is fuzzy.

=== Meeting followups ===
- Sync w/ infra: request perf table (email Owen + CC infra-oncall)
- Add quick tests to examples repo (create GH issue, assign Sasha)
- Schedule 30-min docs grooming on Monday (agenda: streaming, embeddings, types)

=== Quick wins roadmap (2-week outlook) ===
- Week 1: shipping Node streaming + Vite note; merge python env fix; add embeddings micro-section.
- Week 2: types fix + small function-calling example + PR to examples repo with tiny TS Vite app.

=== Misc notes / scribbles ===
- Possible tutorial idea: "Deploy a tiny chat widget (TSX) that uses streaming + function calling for tool lookup" — 45 min writeup + sample app.
- Remind: keep code samples under 60 LOC, use consistent param names across SDKs (client vs clientInstance).
- Remove deep explanation from quickstart; link to a long-form cookbook for tradeoffs.

-- end scratchpad --

Timestamp: 2026-03-10 16:45 PKT
